events: select e.pc_0060_id as id, e.name, e.start_at, e.event_type__label as event_type, (select count(*) from associations a join marketing_event_participations p on p.pc_0061_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'marketing_events' and a.other_object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.record_id = e.pc_0060_id) as people from marketing_events e order by e.start_at desc nulls last, e.name

people.sql: select p.pc_0061_id as id, p.priority, p.priority__label as priority_label, p.follow_up_status, p.follow_up_status__label as status_label, p.follow_up_date, p.notes, p.created_at, ct.contact_id, ct.contact, ct.job_title, ct.email, ct.phone, co.company, ev.event_id, ev.event from marketing_event_participations p left join lateral (select c.pc_0010_id as contact_id, c.name as contact, c.job_title, c.email, c.phone from associations a join contacts c on c.pc_0010_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.other_object = 'contacts' and a.record_id = p.pc_0061_id limit 1) ct on true left join lateral (select x.pc_0011_id as company_id, x.name as company from associations a join companies x on x.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'contacts' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = ct.contact_id order by x.name limit 1) co on true left join lateral (select e.pc_0060_id as event_id, e.name as event from associations a join marketing_events e on e.pc_0060_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.other_object = 'marketing_events' and a.record_id = p.pc_0061_id limit 1) ev on true where (:event is null or ev.event_id = :event) and (p.priority is not null or p.follow_up_status is not null) order by p.follow_up_date nulls last, p.created_at desc limit 2000

statuses: select property, api_value, label, color from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0061' and property in ('priority', 'follow_up_status') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
